issues.title: Migrations that alter SQLite table structure can cause data loss
[#55866] Fix SQLite3 data loss during table alterations with CASCADE foreign keys.
[FIx #55866] Fix SQLite3 data loss or corruption when altering tables inside a transaction (follow up to PR #55907)
[BUG]: Migration generator silently causes cascade data loss during SQLite table recreation without warning
[BUG]: SQLite table-rebuild migrations silently wipe child tables for any FK with `ON DELETE CASCADE`

findings.detail: SQLite ignores attempts to turn PRAGMA foreign_keys OFF while a transaction is active.
findings.remediation: Set PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF before starting the transaction, restore it after the migration, and run PRAGMA foreign_key_check.
findings.title: PRAGMA foreign_keys inside a transaction is a no-op

findings.detail: Dependent table `children` references rebuilt table `parents` with ON DELETE CASCADE on line 3; dropping the original table can delete dependent rows while foreign-key enforcement is active.
findings.remediation: Disable foreign-key enforcement before starting the transaction, perform the rebuild, then restore enforcement and run PRAGMA foreign_key_check; prefer a native ALTER TABLE or staged migration when available.
findings.title: table rebuild may trigger ON DELETE CASCADE data loss

findings.title: PRAGMA foreign_keys inside a transaction is a no-op
